tail -7 /tmp/projects-export-build-4.log; cat >> analysis/projects-export-2026-10-28/architecture.md <<'MD'

Direct worker startup uses the existing automation-host approach: an eager, two-pixel offscreen iframe, parent-bound readiness probes on load and periodically, and a 90-second startup deadline. Display-none frames can defer browser initialization. Canonical terminal status also retires an unresponsive frame, so cancellation can finish even when readiness never arrives. Worker error/timeout requests cancellation of remaining direct jobs; normal completion and terminal polling fence advancement by job identity to avoid skipping the next batch item.
MD
